entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to process a return for some cycling shoes I bought a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have the order number or the email address associated with the account?
Sure, the order number is VF-8675309.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Velocity cycling shoes, delivered on October 18th. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's a fit issue. I've tried to break them in on several rides, but they keep giving me terrible blisters on my heels. I've adjusted the cleats and tried different socks, but nothing helps. They're just not the right shape for my feet.
I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Comfort is key. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.
Okay, I've reviewed your order. Since it was delivered 59 days ago, you are still well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate you approving the refund. Since I do need a new pair, and I'll be buying them from VeloFit, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase, given the trouble with the blisters?

I understand your request. While I can't add a discount code on top of a full refund, I can certainly walk you through some of our other cycling shoes that have a wider toe box or different heel construction. We could find a pair that's a much better fit to prevent any future issues.
Alright, I suppose that's fair. A full refund is the most important part. I'll take a look at the other models on the website myself.

Perfect. I have just processed the return authorization. You will receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
